name: The library
about: A reading room after hours. Your job is the open book on the desk, the voices write in its margin, finished dies stand on the shelf.

words.note: Leave a note for the librarian.

names: open until you close the book
gags: Someone pencilled in a margin: 'tested myself here, got it wrong, remembered it forever.'
stamps a due date on nothing in particular. Old habit.
The night owl has twelve books open and is reading none of them. He calls it interleaving.
The gramophone skips on the same note every time. Nobody gets up to fix it. It's part of the room now.
A card in the catalogue reads: SEE ALSO: sleep.
shelves a book you finished last week. 'You'll want it again in a few days,' she says. She's right.
Somebody left flashcards in the returns slot. All of them answered, none of them read.

lines.play: A play block. Even the librarian puts down her pencil. Fun is on the reading list.
lines.evening: Evening. The library fills up around now. Nobody else at these desks brought homework.
lines.friday: Friday night, and you're in the library. The night owl nods at you. Quietly.
lines.silent: Nothing graded in {days} days. The librarian is dusting the same shelf.
lines.newyear: New year. Same desk. The volumes don't unbind.
lines.nye: Last night of the year. Bind the volume, not just the year.
lines.halloween: Halloween. Someone hid a skeleton in anatomy. It's been there since 1987.
lines.valentine: Valentine's Day. Two people keep reaching for the same book. The librarian pretends not to notice.
lines.music_quiet: The gramophone is quiet. Press play, or keep the silence. This is a library.

lines.day: One more book on the pile. The librarian stamps it without looking up.
lines.week: A full week of evenings. The librarian sets a brass bookend on your shelf.
lines.die: A volume, bound. It goes on the shelf with your name on the spine.
lines.gift: The librarian left something on your desk. It's on the shelf.
